subject.title: fix: resolve Tavily SecretRefs in agent tools

question: Should this broader PR be the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/95109 and supersede https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95110, or should the Tavily-only fix land separately while the agent runtime-snapshot repair is split out?
rationale: Both PRs are technically credible and proof-positive, but only this PR includes the additional shared agent Tool Search runtime-config correction; automation cannot choose permanent ownership between overlapping landing candidates.

options.title: Land the broader canonical fix
options.body: Refresh this PR against current main, require exact-head gates, land both guarded fixes together, and close the narrower overlapping PR as superseded.

options.title: Split ownership
options.body: Land the Tavily-only PR and move this PR's shared agent runtime-snapshot correction into a separate narrowly scoped branch.

options.title: Pause both candidates
options.body: Keep both PRs open while an owner revalidates whether the shared runtime selector should remain agent-specific or become a broader config API.

recommendation.title: Land the broader canonical fix
recommendation.body: Refresh this PR against current main, require exact-head gates, land both guarded fixes together, and close the narrower overlapping PR as superseded.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the clearest decision owner because they assigned, updated, and authored the consolidated current PR head.
